requirement_ref.quote: A "Shop by Category" section with interactive buttons to filter products by: All, Electronics, Fashion, and Books.

preconditions: STAGE is reachable and the home page loads with the full product catalog

The catalog currently has exactly 2 Electronics products (Wireless Headphones, Bluetooth Speaker) — this assertion is pinned to that fact and needs updating if the catalog changes (see thinking/analysis/ecommerce-2026-09-12.md, Regression impact)
test_objective: Verify that selecting the Electronics category filter narrows the product grid to only Electronics products.

actions.instruction: Wait for the grid to re-render.

assertions.statement: Exactly 2 products are shown after filtering to Electronics (matching the current catalog's Electronics count).

target.description: Add to Cart buttons across the visible product grid
target.name: Add to Cart
